title: Captain Milo and the Golden Shell
moral: Staying together and helping each other makes challenges easier.

scenes.summary: Captain Milo begins a journey to find a magical shell.
scenes.text: Captain Milo and his crew set out to find the Golden Shell of Calm Seas.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate captain with crew sailing cheerful sea cartoon style
scenes.story: Captain Milo sailed with his crew to find a golden shell that could calm the sea. A storm came, but they stayed together and followed dolphins who showed the safe way. They reached an island and found the glowing shell. The sea became calm again. They felt proud and safe, knowing teamwork helped them succeed.
